newsitem.title: UK: Nat Grid faces 1.0 bln stg revenue cut -FT.
newsitem.headline: Nat Grid faces 1.0 bln stg revenue cut -FT.

text.p: National Grid, which owns and operates the high-voltage electricity transmission system in England and Wales, is expected to be ordered by the UK's electricity regulator Offer to cut prices to reduce revenues by around 1.0 billion stg, the Financial Times said on Thursday.

The paper said Offer would tell National Grid to reduce revenues from next April to March 2002. National Grid has said the proposals are too tough and is expected to consider challenging the order before the Monopolies and Mergers Commission (MMC), it added.
The FT said Offer's final proposals would secure a 20 percent cut in Grid charges in their first year of operation.
